2115515122265542825.en_summary: Breaking: This might be Leopold Aschenbrenner's worst trade. Situational Awareness bought 10K shares of $CBRS. Cerebras builds giant AI chips meant to run faster than Nvidia's GPUs. $CBRS is down 9.4% today after short seller Culper Research said the chips only last 1.5 to 2.5 years in the field. Culper also claims the proprietary cooling material is actually 1980s tech, and hidden software keeps the chips running nonstop just so they don't crack when cooling. $CBRS down 65%+ since May IPO and we see if Leopold still holds it on November 16th.
2115515122265542825.zh_summary: 突發：這可能是利奧波德·阿申布倫納最糟糕的交易。Situational Awareness買入了1萬股$CBRS。Cerebras製造旨在比英偉達GPU運行更快的巨型人工智能芯片。$CBRS今天下跌9.4%，因為空頭賣家Culper Research稱芯片在現場只能持續1.5到2.5年。Culper還聲稱專有冷卻材料實際上是1980年代技術，隱藏軟件讓芯片不停運行以免冷卻時破裂。$CBRS自5月IPO以來下跌65%以上，我們看看利奧波德是否在11月16日仍持有。

ticker_notes.CBRS: 空頭報告稱芯片壽命短、冷卻技術存疑，今日跌9.4%，自IPO跌超65%

2115514938127224875.en_summary: (Reposted by @petenajarian) NXP Semiconductors beats but the stock slips on soft guidance. $NXPI fell roughly 4 to 8% even after record revenue of $3.79 billion, up 19%, EPS of $4.20 and a new $5 billion buyback, because fourth quarter revenue guidance of about $3.85 billion came in a touch light.
2115514938127224875.zh_summary: （由@petenajarian轉發）恩智浦半導體業績超預期，但因指引疲軟股價下跌。$NXPI下跌約4%至8%，儘管創紀錄收入37.9億美元，增長19%，EPS 4.20美元，並推出新的50億美元回購，但第四季度收入指引約38.5億美元略低於預期。
